'''Narisse''' was a [[Jenn Aiel]].

==Appearance==
Narisse had graying hair and deep-set green eyes.{{ref/book|4|25}}

==History==
Narisse, along with [[Dermon]] and [[Mordaine]], speak for the Jenn Aiel. They allow the [[Aiel]] to send their sept chiefs and [[Wise Ones]] to [[Rhuidean]]. They do this to preserve ''[[ji'e'toh]]'' and the [[Prophecy of Rhuidean]].{{ref/book|4|25}}
